name: Tentacle
description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and the tentacle can’t be used to attack a different target. The creature has two tentacles, each of which can grapple one target. When the creature moves, it can drag a Medium or smaller target it is grappling at full speed.
